title: Look it up or say why
description:
A program loads a DLL at run time and looks up several functions with `GetProcAddress`. If any is missing it should say which. Write

```cpp
std::string missingFunctions(const std::set<std::string>& exports, const std::vector<std::string>& wanted);
```

Return an empty string if every wanted name is exported. Otherwise return `"missing: "` followed by the missing names in the order they were wanted, separated by `", "`. Names are case-sensitive, as `GetProcAddress` is.

```
missingFunctions({ "stackHeight", "stackWeight" }, { "stackHeight", "layers", "Stackweight" })
    == "missing: layers, Stackweight"
```
lessonTitle: Run-Time Loading with LoadLibrary and GetProcAddress
